terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms of use govern access to and use of the Stack32 service, published by {{companyName}}. By creating an account or using Stack32, you accept these terms.

sections.title: 1. The service
sections.body: Stack32 lets you create, test and use AI agents by describing them in natural language. The service includes a builder interface, a live chat with your agents, and a structure view of their configuration. Stack32 is provided as a web application accessible with a compatible browser.

sections.title: 2. Account
sections.body: You must create an account to use the product. You are responsible for the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activity performed through your account. You must provide accurate information and be at least 15 years old, or have parental consent.

sections.title: 3. Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree not to use Stack32 to generate or spread illegal, harmful or misleading content; not to attempt to bypass technical limits or security measures; not to infringe third-party rights; and not to resell the service without authorization. We may suspend accounts that violate these rules.

sections.title: 4. AI-generated content
sections.body: Agents produce content automatically. Despite automated testing, results may be incomplete, inaccurate or inappropriate for your use case. You remain responsible for reviewing and using agent outputs. Stack32 does not guarantee the accuracy of generated content.

sections.title: 5. Your content
sections.body: You retain ownership of the content you submit (prompts, documents, knowledge sources). You grant {{companyName}} the licenses strictly necessary to operate the service, including processing your content through third-party AI model providers.

sections.title: 6. Subscriptions
sections.body: Some features require a paid subscription. Prices, billing and cancellation are described in the Subscription & Sales Terms. Billing is handled by our payment provider, Whop.

sections.title: 7. Availability
sections.body: We strive to keep Stack32 available and reliable, but the service is provided "as is", without guarantee of uninterrupted availability. We may modify or discontinue features with reasonable notice.

sections.title: 8. Liability
sections.body: To the extent permitted by law, {{companyName}}'s liability is limited to the amounts you paid for the service during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded by law.

sections.title: 9. Termination
sections.body: You may stop using the service and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate accounts in case of breach of these terms, with notice where reasonably possible.

sections.title: 10. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by French law. Any dispute that cannot be resolved amicably will be submitted to the competent French courts.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data {{companyName}} collects through Stack32, why, and what your rights are.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.body: The data controller is {{companyName}}, {{registeredAddress}}. Contact: {{contactEmail}}.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
sections.body: Account data (email, name, password hash); profile data provided during onboarding (first name, phone number, role, discovery source, use case); content you submit (prompts, conversations, documents); usage data (features used, technical logs); and billing data processed by our payment provider.

sections.title: 3. Why we process it
sections.body: To provide the service (create and run your agents), to secure accounts, to improve the product, to provide support, to handle billing, and to comply with legal obligations. Legal bases include contract performance, legitimate interest and legal obligations.

sections.title: 4. AI processing
sections.body: Your prompts and connected documents are processed by AI model providers acting as processors, strictly to generate your agents' answers. We do not use your private content to train our own models.

sections.title: 5. Sharing
sections.body: Data is shared only with processors necessary to run the service (hosting, database, AI model providers, payment provider, analytics), under data-processing agreements. We do not sell personal data.

sections.title: 6. Retention
sections.body: Account data is kept while your account is active, then deleted or anonymized within the legal limitation periods. You can request deletion at any time.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction and objection, and the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (French supervisory authority). To exercise your rights, contact {{contactEmail}}.

sections.title: 8. Security
sections.body: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures: encryption in transit, access controls, isolation of customer data and least-privilege access.

sections.title: 9. Transfers outside the EU
sections.body: Some processors may be located outside the European Union. In that case, transfers are protected by appropriate safeguards such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This policy describes the cookies and similar technologies used by Stack32.

sections.title: 1. What cookies are
sections.body: Cookies are small files stored on your device by your browser. They can be strictly necessary to run the service, or used for measurement and personalization.

sections.title: 2. Cookies we use
sections.body: Strictly necessary cookies: authentication session, security, language preference. These do not require consent. Measurement cookies: if we add privacy-friendly analytics, this policy will be updated and consent requested where required.

sections.title: 3. Local storage
sections.body: Stack32 uses your browser's local storage to remember your language and, in development mode, to store demo data locally on your device.

sections.title: 4. Managing cookies
sections.body: You can delete cookies and local storage at any time in your browser settings. Blocking strictly necessary cookies may prevent the service from working.

sales.title: Subscription & sales terms
sales.intro: These terms apply to paid subscriptions to Stack32, sold by {{companyName}}.

sections.title: 1. Offer
sections.body: Stack32 is offered as a monthly subscription giving access to the features described on the pricing page. Features and limits of each plan are described at the time of purchase.

sections.title: 2. Price and payment
sections.body: Prices are shown in the checkout flow, taxes indicated where applicable. Payment is processed by our payment provider, Whop. The subscription renews automatically each period until canceled.

sections.title: 3. Right of withdrawal
sections.body: For consumers in the EU, the subscription gives immediate access to digital content. By subscribing, you expressly request immediate execution and acknowledge that the 14-day right of withdrawal is waived once the service has been fully accessed, in accordance with the French Consumer Code.

sections.title: 4. Cancellation
sections.body: You can cancel at any time from your billing settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Access remains active until then.

sections.title: 5. Price changes
sections.body: We may change prices with at least 30 days' notice. Changes apply from the next renewal. If you disagree, you can cancel before the new price takes effect.

sections.title: 6. Fair use
sections.body: Usage limits (number of agents, runs, knowledge volume) are described per plan. We may throttle abusive usage that threatens platform stability, with notice where possible.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.intro: This policy explains when refunds apply to Stack32 subscriptions sold by {{companyName}}.

sections.title: 1. General principle
sections.body: Subscription periods already started are in principle non-refundable, since the service is a digital content made available immediately.

sections.title: 2. Service failure
sections.body: If a major malfunction attributable to Stack32 prevented you from using the service for a significant part of a billing period, contact us: we will examine a pro-rata refund or credit in good faith.

sections.title: 3. Billing errors
sections.body: Any duplicate or erroneous charge will be refunded in full after verification.

sections.title: 4. How to ask
sections.body: Send your request to {{contactEmail}} with the email of your account and the invoice concerned. We answer within 7 business days. Refunds are issued through the original payment method via our payment provider.

sections.title: 5. Statutory rights
sections.body: Nothing in this policy limits your statutory rights, including legal guarantees applicable to digital services.
